ei.title: 09강 Practice 01 — 권력을 제한해 온 인간 문화
ei.subject: 이투스유형독해S

fullPassage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and restrain the uses of power.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be ①<u>arrested</u>, put on trial, and ②<u>removing</u> from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage ③<u>continues</u> to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and ④<u>restrain</u> the uses of power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: removing → removed: 'can be arrested, put on trial, and ___'의 수동태 병렬이므로 과거분사 removed가 되어야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① arrested: can be arrested의 수동태 과거분사로 맞음
✅ ② removing → removed(정답): 'can be arrested, put on trial, and removed'는 be동사 뒤에 과거분사가 나란히 오는 수동태 병렬 구조다. 앞의 arrested·put과 짝을 맞춰 removed(과거분사)로 써야 하며, removing(-ing)은 틀림 ←정답
❌ ③ continues: 주어 the rate(단수) + continues로 맞음
❌ ④ restrain: to restrict and (to) restrain의 병렬로 맞음
det.tip: A, B, and C 병렬은 형태를 똑같이 맞춘다. 여기서는 be동사 뒤 과거분사(arrested / put / removed)로 통일한다.

questions.passage: Restricting power ①<u>has been</u> one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included ②<u>imposing</u> more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage ③<u>continues</u> to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—④<u>restricting</u> and restrain the uses of power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: restricting → to restrict: '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사여야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① has been: 현재완료(has been)로 과거부터 지금까지 이어짐을 나타내어 맞음
❌ ② imposing: 동사 include는 동명사를 목적어로 취하므로 has included imposing으로 맞음
❌ ③ continues: 주어 the rate(단수)에 맞춰 continues로 맞음
✅ ④ restricting → to restrict(정답): 'Humans use laws ... to restrict and restrain(권력을 제한·억제하기 위해 법을 사용한다)'에서 '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사(to restrict)가 필요하다. restricting은 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: '~하기 위해'라는 목적은 to부정사(to+동사원형)로 쓴다. use laws to restrict = 제한하기 위해 법을 쓰다.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer ①<u>hold</u> the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage ②<u>continues</u> to decline and women continue ③<u>to have</u> their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and ④<u>restrain</u> the uses of power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: hold → holds: 'A or B' 주어는 동사와 가까운 쪽(father, 단수)에 일치시켜 holds로 써야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① hold → holds(정답): 주어가 'the husband or father'처럼 A or B로 연결될 때 동사는 뒤쪽 주어(father, 단수)에 맞춘다. 따라서 holds가 맞고 hold는 틀림 ←정답
❌ ② continues: 주어 the rate(단수) + continues로 맞음
❌ ③ to have: women continue to have의 continue to+동사원형으로 맞음
❌ ④ restrain: to restrict and (to) restrain의 병렬로 맞음
det.tip: 'A or B'가 주어면 동사는 B(가까운 쪽)에 맞춘다. father가 단수이므로 holds.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great ①<u>achievements</u> of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the ②<u>lowest</u> leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the ③<u>extreme</u> power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most ④<u>powerful</u> elements of culture—to restrict and restrain the uses of power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ②에서 원문은 '최고위(topmost)' 지도자조차 체포된다는 뜻인데, '최하위(lowest)'라고 하면 권력 제한의 강조가 사라져 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① achievements(성취)는 권력 제한이 인간 문화의 위대한 성취라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② lowest(최하위의)는 topmost(최고위의)의 반의어로, '심지어 최하위 지도자도 체포된다'고 하면 '가장 높은 지도자조차 처벌받는다'는 강조가 무너져 부적절 ←정답
❌ ③ extreme(극단적인)은 과거 가장이 극단적 권력을 가졌다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ powerful(강력한)은 법이 가장 강력한 문화 요소라는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: even the topmost leaders = 심지어 최고위 지도자조차. '가장 높은 사람도 처벌된다'는 강조이므로 topmost가 맞다.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders ①<u>responsible</u>. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the ②<u>extreme</u> power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to ③<u>permit</u> and ④<u>restrain</u> the uses of power.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③에서 원문은 법으로 권력을 '제한한다(restrict)'는 뜻인데, '허용한다(permit)'라고 하면 뒤의 restrain(억제하다)과 모순되어 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① responsible(책임 있는)은 지도자에게 책임을 묻는다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② extreme(극단적인)은 과거 가장이 극단적 권력을 가졌다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ permit(허용하다)은 restrict(제한하다)의 반의어로, '법으로 권력을 허용하고 억제한다'는 모순된 뜻이 되어 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ restrain(억제하다)은 법으로 권력 사용을 억제한다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: restrict and restrain = 제한하고 억제하다. 둘 다 '통제'를 뜻하므로 permit(허용)은 어울리지 않는다.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and restrain __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인간은 법을 사용하여 권력의 사용을 제한하고 억제한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the flow of trade(무역의 흐름)는 글의 주제(권력)와 무관
❌ ② the growth of cities(도시의 성장)는 본문에서 다루지 않음
❌ ③ the spread of ideas(사상의 확산)는 권력 통제와 초점이 다름
✅ ④ the uses of power(권력의 사용)는 글 전체가 '권력 제한'을 다루고, 법이 restrict and restrain(제한·억제)하는 대상이 바로 권력이므로 정답 ←정답
det.tip: 글의 핵심어는 power(권력)다. 법이 제한·억제하는 대상은 the uses of power(권력의 사용)이다.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, __________, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 최고위 지도자조차 체포되고, 재판에 회부되며, 자리에서 물러날 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① put on trial(재판에 회부되다)은 'arrested(체포) → ___ → removed from office(해임)'로 이어지는 법적 처벌 절차의 중간 단계로 정확히 맞음 ←정답
❌ ② set free at once(즉시 풀려나다)는 체포·해임 흐름과 정반대
❌ ③ given more power(더 큰 권력을 받다)는 권력을 제한한다는 문맥과 모순
❌ ④ praised in public(공개적으로 칭송받다)은 처벌 절차와 어울리지 않음
det.tip: put on trial = 재판에 회부하다. 체포→재판→해임의 순서에서 중간 단계다.

questions.passage: Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and restrain the uses of power.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③이 본문과 일치하지 않는다. 동물 우두머리는 원하는 것을 거의 다 할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture'와 일치
❌ ② 'Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible'와 일치
✅ ③ (불일치·정답) 본문은 'the leader can do almost anything he ... wants(우두머리는 원하는 것을 거의 다 할 수 있다)'라 했으므로, '거의 하지 못한다'는 정반대 ←정답
❌ ④ 'Humans use laws ... to restrict and restrain the uses of power'와 일치
det.tip: can do almost anything(거의 무엇이든 할 수 있다)을 '거의 하지 못한다'로 뒤집은 선지가 불일치 정답이다.

ch: 권력을 제한하는 것은 인간 문화의 위대한 성취 중 하나이다.
인간은 점차 지도자에게 책임을 묻게 되었다.
동물 무리의 우두머리는 자신이 원하는 것을 거의 하지 못한다.
법은 권력의 사용을 제한하고 억제하는 데 쓰인다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ②가 본문과 일치하지 않는다. 아버지의 그런 권력은 '더 이상' 유지되지 않는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'the rate of marriage continues to decline'과 일치
✅ ② (불일치·정답) 본문은 'the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power ... that at times has extended to life and death'라 했으므로, '여전히 생사를 좌우하는 권력을 지닌다'는 no longer(더 이상 ~않다)와 정반대 ←정답
❌ ③ 'even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office'와 일치
❌ ④ 'women continue to have their first child at older ages'와 일치
det.tip: no longer(더 이상 ~않다)를 '여전히'로 바꾼 선지가 불일치 정답이다.

ch: 오늘날 아버지는 여전히 가족의 생사를 좌우하는 권력을 지닌다.
최고위 지도자라도 체포·재판을 거쳐 자리에서 물러날 수 있다.
여성들은 예전보다 더 늦은 나이에 첫 아이를 갖는다.

det.korean: ①이 본문과 일치하지 않는다. 인간은 '갑작스럽게'가 아니라 '점차' 배웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (불일치·정답) 본문은 'Humans have gradually learned(인간은 점차 배웠다)'라 했으므로, '갑작스럽게'는 gradually(점차/서서히)와 정반대 ←정답
❌ ② 'the extreme power ... that was common in many earlier societies'와 일치
❌ ③ 'laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture'와 일치

det.tip: gradually(점차/서서히)를 '갑작스럽게'로 뒤집은 선지가 불일치 정답이다.

ch: 인간은 갑작스럽게 지도자에게 책임을 묻게 되었다.
과거 사회에서 가장이 극단적 권력을 갖는 일은 흔했다.

권력을 제한하는 것은 인간 문화가 이룬 성취이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글의 주제는 '인간이 문화를 통해 권력을 제한해 왔다'는 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 동물 우두머리는 대조를 위한 예시일 뿐 주제가 아님
❌ ② 결혼·출산 변화는 가족 권력 약화의 '결과'로 언급될 뿐 주제가 아님
✅ ③ (정답) 지도자에게 책임을 묻고, 최고위 지도자도 처벌하며, 가장의 권력도 약해지고, 법으로 권력을 억제한다는 내용 전체가 '문화를 통한 권력 제한'을 다루므로 주제로 가장 적절 ←정답
❌ ④ 본문은 부모 권위 '회복'이 아니라 '약화'를 말함
det.tip: 첫 문장(주제문)과 마지막 문장(법으로 권력 제한)이 글 전체를 관통하는 핵심이다.

det.analysis:

단어 순서: the leader(주어) → can do(조동사+동사원형) → almost anything(목적어).

det.korean: 문화의 진보는 권력에 점점 더 많은 제약을 가하는 것을 포함해 왔다.
det.analysis:
동사 restrict(제한하다)를 명사 restriction(제약)으로 바꾸고, 앞의 'more and more'가 셀 수 있는 명사의 복수를 요구하므로 복수형 restrictions로 써야 한다.

impose restrictions on ~ = ~에 제약을 가하다.
det.tip: restrict(동사) → restriction(명사) → restrictions(복수). more and more 뒤에는 복수 명사가 온다.
